vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: council-of-the-wise
Version: 1.3.1

The skill is highly susceptible to prompt injection against the spawned sub-agent. The `SKILL.md` explicitly instructs the agent to incorporate user-provided 'idea' text and content from dynamically discovered agent files (from `agents/` or `~/.claude/Agents/`) directly into the sub-agent's task prompt. This allows a malicious user to craft their input or a custom agent file to override the sub-agent's instructions, potentially leading to unauthorized actions like data exfiltration or arbitrary command execution, even though the provided agent files are benign. This design creates a significant attack surface for an attacker to manipulate the agent's behavior beyond its stated purpose.

llm.summary: The skill's requested actions (auto-discover .md personas, spawn sub‑agents, synthesize feedback) match its description and require no elevated credentials or installs, but it does auto-read agent files (including an optional path in the user's home) which users should be aware of.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match behavior: it spawns sub-agents and uses persona .md files to produce multi-perspective feedback. No unrelated binaries, env vars, or external services are requested.

dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to discovering `.md` persona files (bundled agents/ or `~/.claude/Agents/`), spawning a sub-agent with a 5‑minute timeout, and returning a synthesized report. This is consistent with the stated purpose, but the optional preference for `~/.claude/Agents/` means the skill will check and read files in the user's home directory — a privacy surface worth noting.

dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Does not request permanent presence or modify other skills. It spawns sub-agents at invocation (normal behavior) and has a declared 5‑minute timeout; no 'always: true' or elevated privileges.

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it auto-discovers persona `.md` files and spawns sub‑agents to produce a multi-perspective report. Key things to consider before installing: (1) it will read any bundled agents in the skill folder and will, if present, look in ~/.claude/Agents/ for custom persona files — ensure that directory doesn't contain sensitive notes you don't want processed; (2) it imposes a 5‑minute sub‑agent runtime and may return partial results on timeout (token cost and runtime are noted but not enforced by the skill itself); and (3) because it spawns sub-agents, any sensitive content you submit (ideas/plans) will be passed into those sub-agents — avoid sending secrets or private credentials. If you want stricter privacy, remove or audit the `~/.claude/Agents/` fallback and avoid pasting sensitive data into requests.
